breakdown.reason: The agent kept c = 2 from the incorrect parameter section while also retaining the PDE with coefficient (1.0)**2. The ground truth resolves this by setting c = 1.0 to match the PDE. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency and even uses c = 2 in the CFL and time-stepping formulas, which would produce incorrect numerical results.
